name: Privilege demo LAB
description: An AI agent's MCP tool calls pass a policy enforcement point that decides allow, deny or hold with Cedar. Runs offline in mock mode (in-process mock issuer and tool backends) or verifies Bearer tokens from your own PingFederate in live mode.
notes: Host-run: npm install && npm run build && npm start (port 4510, loopback only; mock mode needs no settings). Docker: docker compose up --build -d (publishes 127.0.0.1:4510 only). Catalog id D1 (PingOne Privilege, AI gateway), with Cedar as its AI Policies engine.
